question: Can the app offer a streaming catalog like the original service?
probes: Person confirms a licensed music source or API they want to use
resolution: Every well-known song now shows: Deezer's public catalogue (no key) gives search, top charts, real cover art and 30-second previews, verified live (found "Blinding Lights", preview and covers download and decode; screenshots show real chart songs). Full-length playback of major-label songs is not possible through any public API (Spotify's API only links out), so preview songs offer "Full song on Spotify". Jamendo (person's own free key) still gives full-length independent songs. No keys copied from GitHub.
